verdict.rationale: Kong is an API gateway/proxy product that manages traffic to backend APIs, not a client-side API testing/scripting tool where a developer writes pre-request/post-response scripts to chain calls and manipulate data (e.g., Postman-style collection scripting). While Kong offers request/response transformation plugins for production traffic shaping, this is a different axis than developer-authored chained test scripts, so the story does not apply to this product category.
